title: NOVEL ASPECTS OF ASYMMETRIC BROMOLACTONIZATION REACTION
abstract: Abstract                Asymmetric bromolactonization reaction was found to proceed highly stereo- and regiospecifically via the transition state such as 5II when (S)-N-(α,β-unsaturated acyl)-α-amino acid, where two alkyl groups are located at the α and β positions in a cis relationship and free rotation of the bond between asymmetric carbon and nitrogen is prohibited due to cyclic structure, is used as a reaction substrate.
